data.name: DR Dominoes
data.detailed_description:
The table is set

In the Caribbean, dominoes isn't a pastime. It's a conversation. It gets played outside the corner store, under the carport, at the end of a meal nobody wants to end. DR Dominoes brings that table to your screen: same rules, same tension, same people. Even if they're three thousand miles away.

Tiles in 3D with real weight, real light, real sound. A table you can read at a glance. No endless menus. Just you, your partner, and seven tiles.

The table talks

Dominoes is won with your hand and played with your mouth. This isn't flat voice chat where everybody comes through the same channel at the same volume. This is a table — and at a table, everybody has a chair.

  • Proximity voice chat: you hear every player from where they're sitting. Your partner, across from you. The one about to lock up the table, on your left. You hear him coming.

  • Text chat: for when you don't want the mic on — or when the comment deserves to be in writing.

The table sounds like a table: the slap of a tile on wood, the guy complaining, and the one who already knows what's coming and hasn't said a word.

House rules

  • Double-six set. 28 tiles. Four players, two teams.

  • No boneyard, no drawing. Seven tiles each — you play what you were dealt, or you pass.

  • Leads, passes, blocked games, capicúas. The whole vocabulary, nothing trimmed.

  • Games to 100, 120, 150 or 200 points. You decide whether it's a quick round or a war.

  • The chain turns the corner when it runs out of table, just like the real thing. No tiles wandering off into nowhere.

Get a game going

  • Offline mode: the full table against the AI. No internet, no excuses.

  • Private rooms: share a code and everybody's seated in seconds.

  • Room browser: drop into a public table that's still filling up.

  • Reconnect: if your connection drops, your chair is still there.

  • Stats: your profile keeps count. Wins, blocks, win rate — everything you'll need the next time somebody doubts you.

When nobody's around

The AI in DR Dominoes isn't there to fill seats. It counts tiles, remembers what you passed on, and locks up the table when you least expect it. Use it to practice, to round out a partnership, or just to play in peace on a Sunday afternoon.

On Steam

  • Invite your Steam friends straight from the overlay.

  • Your friends list, right there in the lobby.

  • Native builds for Windows, macOS and Linux.

Pull up a chair. Shuffle. And don't get caught holding the double six.
